content.short: Sanctum is a liquid staking layer on Solana that unifies LST liquidity via the multi-asset Infinity Pool for all.
content.description: Sanctum is a pioneering decentralized protocol built natively on the Solana blockchain, designed to solve the problem of fragmented liquidity within the liquid staking ecosystem. The platform features the Infinity Pool, a multi-asset liquidity layer that allows users to deposit any Solana-based Liquid Staking Token (LST) to receive INF, a highly composable asset representing a diversified basket of staking rewards. This approach ensures that users can maximize their yields while maintaining deep liquidity for use across the broader Solana DeFi landscape for global participants.
content.meta: Sanctum provides unified liquid staking and high-efficiency liquidity pools for Solana. Discover Sanctum and more on the Lancers Web3 Explorer today.
